About Pravin Realty

Your Trusted West Pune Real Estate Partner

Welcome to Pravin Realty, your trusted partner in Pune's dynamic real estate market. Based in Balewadi, Pune, we specialize in the flourishing markets of West Pune and the greater Pune region, offering complete real estate solutions for buying, selling, renting, leasing, and investing in residential, commercial, land, and luxury properties.

Whether you are searching for your next home, looking for the right commercial space, planning to sell or lease your property, or exploring a promising investment, Pravin Realty is here to make the process straightforward and rewarding.

Pravin KumbharFounder & CEO

Chapter 1 — About

Your partner in Pune's real estate.

Based in Balewadi, Pravin Realty offers trusted real estate services across West Pune and the greater Pune region, including Baner, Balewadi, Wakad, Tathawade, Punawale, Hinjawadi and surrounding areas. We specialize in buying, selling, renting, leasing and investing in residential, commercial, land and luxury properties, helping you find the right property to match your needs and goals.
